verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pods pricing docs offer upfront 3-month or 6-month commitments for discounted compute. The pricing page also routes reserved capacity and contract pricing through enterprise sales, so committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity are a documented first-party offering. Missing for 10: specific discount rates or terms detail, clarity on whether capacity is actually guaranteed under self-serve commitments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity

citations.quote: Commit to a 3-month or 6-month term upfront for significant discounts on compute costs.
For reserved capacity and contract pricing, speak to our enterprise sales team.
